annotation.title_clean: Act 468 of 2019 (HB 1561): An Act to Authorize the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles or Fully Autonomous Vehicles on the Streets and Highways of this State Under an Autonomous Vehicle Pilot Program
annotation.title_en: Act 468 of 2019 (HB 1561): An Act to Authorize the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles or Fully Autonomous Vehicles on the Streets and Highways of this State Under an Autonomous Vehicle Pilot Program
named_instruments_referenced: Arkansas Motor Vehicle Safety Responsibility Act
annotation.summary_en: Arkansas Act 468 of 2019 (HB 1561) authorizes autonomous and fully autonomous vehicles on state roads under a pilot program approved by the State Highway Commission, defining key terms using SAE levels, setting program content requirements, and declaring an emergency to foster innovation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Autonomous vehicles may operate under a pilot program approved by the State Highway Commission, auto-approved after 60 days.
Pilot programs must state commercial purpose, insurance requirements, and acknowledge compliance with traffic laws.
Fully autonomous vehicles must achieve a minimal risk condition upon system failure.
Vehicles without seat belts, steering wheel or rearview mirror may be operated; max three vehicles simultaneously.
Commission must adopt implementing rules; emergency clause justified by innovation.
